notes: Evidence is thin; most facets rely on general knowledge of News Corp.

print_digital_revenue_mix_publishers.value: Mixed: growing digital subscriptions and online services alongside still-significant print newspaper and physical book revenue

publication_print_market.value: Business and financial news, national and metropolitan newspapers, consumer books, real estate listings

advertising_circulation_dependence_publi.value: Blend of subscriptions and circulation, advertising, book sales and real estate listing fees
